query: Works That Do Not Satisfy the Originality Requirement
response:
Based on the provided context, I can answer your question.

Works that do not satisfy the originality requirement are those that:

1. Are mere copies of another work (see Section 313.4(A) "Mere Copies").
2. Lack even a modest degree of originality (see Section 311.2 "The Originality Requirement for Derivative Works" and the cases cited in it).
3. Involve merely changing the size of the preexisting work or recasting a work from one medium to another without any additional creativity (see Section 311.2).

In particular, the U.S. Copyright Office will not register works that do not meet the requirements of independence and creativity.
